findings.claim: ASML 自家 20-F 風險因子載明：若競爭者的替代技術更有效，或客戶轉向較不依賴微影的新架構，業務將受損。
findings.excerpt: Our business will suffer if the technologies that we pursue to assist our customers in producing smaller and more energy-efficient chips are not as effective as those developed by competitors, or if our customers adopt new technological architectures that are less focused on lithography products.

findings.claim: 2026-07 評論指出 EUV 層級對手仍遠遠落後；中國 SMEE 報導已交付早期 28nm ArF 浸潤式 DUV，尚未產品化，被稱為原型階段。
findings.source: Takshashila, ASML's Blowout Quarter Is a Geopolitical Signal (2026-07-17)

findings.claim: Yonhap 報導之分析：即使中國取得 20 台 ArF 浸潤式微影機，對 ASML 2027 年營收影響約 14 億歐元，占整體約 2.4%。
新創 Substrate 於 2025 年底宣稱 X 光微影可媲美 EUV；Bernstein 分析師稱該技術早年已被提出但未能推進，EUV 成熟後被放棄。
findings.source: Finviz: Is ASML's Leadership Threatened After Substrate's Recent Better Technology Claims?

findings.claim: MATCH Act 正於美國國會審議，將禁止對中國銷售新 DUV 並含既有設備維修服務。
findings.source: Search summary of commentary (nasdaq.com 'everyones focused china thats not asmls biggest risk')

substitute_technology.note: as_of 為依檔案年度或網址日期推估（20-F 約 2020 年初；Yonhap/MATCH Act 與 Substrate 僅知約略時間）；除 20-F 外無逐字 excerpt。
